title: The Burning Oath Again
author: Wren Whitlock
blurb: Coral Zhou, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
